    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int b = sc.nextInt();
        int[] arr = new int[n];
        int[] bal = new int[n];
        int x = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = sc.nextInt();
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) x++;
            else x--;
            bal[i] = x;
        }
        List<Integer> costs = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            if (bal[i] == 0) {
                costs.add(Math.abs(arr[i] - arr[i+1]));
            }
        }
        Collections.sort(costs);

        int sum = 0;

            if (sum + cost <= b) {
                sum += cost;
                cuts++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        System.out.print(cuts);
    }
}
